scope: this directory and everything below it
why_this_file_exists: The QA golden set is our own rendered output, so redistribution is ours to grant. Declared explicitly rather than assumed, because scripts/asset_license.py fails CLOSED — an asset that declares nothing is a violation, and 'obviously ours' is precisely the assumption a licence audit exists to stop taking on trust.
note: If a golden-set image is ever replaced by, or composited with, third-party imagery, this declaration stops being true and a SOURCE.json must be placed beside that file.
